summary.en-US: Flat To-Do / In-Progress / Done board, no review cycle.
summary.zh-CN: 扁平的 待办 / 进行中 / 完成 看板，无评审环节。

description.en-US: Simplified Kanban board with To Do, In Progress, and Done columns. Flat work-item hierarchy (Feature, Task, Bug — all roots) with no awaiting-review or revision states. Status transitions are user-driven, with auto-completion of parents when all children are done. Best for small teams, rapid prototyping, or solo workflows where the overhead of explicit review hand-offs would slow you down.
description.zh-CN: 简化版的看板模板，包含 待办、进行中、完成 三列。扁平的工作项层级（功能、任务、缺陷均可作为根节点），不包含 待评审 与 修订 状态。状态流转完全由用户驱动；当所有子项完成后，父项自动完成。适合小团队、快速原型，或不需要显式评审交接的个人工作流。

behaviorRules.name: Auto-complete parent when all children done
